variables: n is length of input array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all n possible sub-arrays of length n - 1 takes O(n^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single pass tracking at most one inversion solves the problem in linear time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles the choice between removing nums[i] versus nums[i - 1] based on nums[i - 2].

hints.title: Single Inversion Budget
hints.text: Iterate through the array and count adjacent pairs where the current element is not strictly greater than the previous.

hints.title: Removal Option Resolution
hints.text: When a violation occurs, choose whether to eliminate the current element or the prior element to preserve monotonicity.

hints.title: Greedy Boundary Update
hints.text: If removing the previous element still leaves an inversion with the element two steps back, update the current element instead.
